summary_1line: Janaka invites Dasaratha and the princes to court, and Vasishtha recounts the long genealogy of the Ikshvaku dynasty leading to Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: King Janaka and King Dasaratha sit among gathered sages while the court listens as Vasishtha begins recounting the ancient lineage.
Queen Kalindi bows before the sage Chyavana in the Himalayas as he foretells that her unborn child will survive the poison.
